podcast.body: Released in the fall of 1980, this album's title "meant literally nothing," according to Stuart Copeland, who said the words just rhymed and rolled off the tongue. The LP solidified The Police's status as New Wave's top band and Sting as its premiere hit-making songwriter, reaching number 5 on the Billboard album chart and going platinum, both firsts for the band. "Released in the fall of 1980, the LP ratified the police as New Wave's top band and Sting as its premiere hit-making songwriter."
